title: Load test
story: N synthetic units on random walks around the AO center, each reporting every few seconds with a short stale. For T&E, Guard Dog CoT-database validation, and sizing. Entity count, report interval and the per-lane rate cap are run parameters.
warn: Every report is a row in TAK's CoT database: 500 units every 2 s is about 250 rows per second, 900,000 rows per hour. Retention will reap them on its normal schedule. The rate cap you set applies to this run only.
